claims.claim: Very sound and working fine borehole drilling machine
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white/cream truck with an orange crane/boom and loading frame; no clear borehole drilling rig components (mast/drill rods/rotary head) are shown, and engine/hydraulics working status is not demonstrated.
Photos show dust/scuffs and worn-looking tires, but do not confirm operational readiness, start/run, or crane/hydraulic performance.
This is a sales remark; photos do not provide proof of buyer suitability or machine condition.

risks.risk: The truck-mounted crane may not be a complete borehole drilling rig (missing key drilling components), so it may not perform borehole drilling as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the full drilling setup: mast/rig, rotary head or percussion hammer, drill rods, swivel, and any borehole tooling mounted and ready to operate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a truck-mounted crane/boom truck only (not a borehole drilling machine), worst-case as non-complete for drilling.

risks.risk: Hydraulic crane/boom may have leaks, weak lift/extend, or poor hold pressure even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Short video clip of the crane/boom performing: lift to height, extend/retract, and hold position without dropping; include a pressure gauge reading if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as hydraulics unproven/possibly needing service (worst-case as not working or leaking).

risks.risk: Engine/transmission/brakes/steering may be faulty; photos cannot confirm it starts and drives reliably.
risks.proof: Video clip: cold start (or start from off), idle sound, gear engagement/drive test, and a brief stop showing brake response.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mechanical condition unknown (worst-case as needs engine/transmission work).

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn/cracked and could require replacement soon; spare availability is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tyres (tread depth/sidewall cracks) plus a photo showing spare tyre and wheel tools.
risks.if_unproven: Price with tyre replacement risk included (worst-case as multiple tyres due).

risks.risk: Electrical and safety systems (lights, indicators, horn, emergency stops) may be incomplete or non-functional.
risks.proof: Walkaround video showing all lights/indicators/horn working (headlights, indicators, brake lights, reverse lights if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical/safety unverified (worst-case as needs rewiring/repairs).

risks.risk: Chassis/frame or mounting points may have hidden structural damage affecting crane stability and safety.
risks.proof: Underbody/side inspection photos of frame rails and crane mounting bolts/brackets; include any visible cracks/weld repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as structural condition unknown (worst-case as frame/mounting repairs needed).

proof_requests: Show the complete borehole drilling rig components mounted on the truck (mast/rig, rotary head or percussion system, drill rods, swivel, tooling) in clear photos/videos.
Provide a video of the crane/boom operating: lift, extend/retract, and hold pressure without drift/drop.
Provide a video of the truck starting, idling, engaging gears, and a short drive/stop test (brakes/steering).
Send close-up tyre photos for all tyres plus a photo of the spare tyre and wheel tools.
Show all lights/indicators/horn working in a walkaround video.
Send photos of the crane mounting points and frame rails (including any welds/cracks) and any recent repair records.
response.reason: The witness confirms a truck-mounted crane/boom, but the seller’s claim that it is a working borehole drilling machine cannot be verified from the photos, and operational proof (start/run and hydraulic performance) is missing. To price correctly, we need proof of the drilling rig completeness and working tests.
